'''Jerasid''' is a farrier from [[Cairhien]] that travels with [[Perrin Aybara]].

==Appearance==
Jerasid is a broad and stocky man, not yet into his middle years.{{ref/book|8|9}}

==Activities==
Given his nationality, it is likely Jerasid was hired after Perrin and Rand return from the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] and before Perrin Travels to [[Ghealdan]].

After arriving in [[Ghealdan]], Jesarid is one of the farriers that look after [[Stepper]] and [[Stayer]], despite Perrin wanting to do the work himself.{{ref/book|8|9}} Jerasid then travels with the group to [[Malden]] to rescue [[Faile Bashere]].{{ref/book|9|6}} Jerasid, [[Aemin]] and [[Falton]] are working the night Faile meets with [[Alliandre Maritha Kigarin]], [[Arrela Shiego]] and [[Lacile Aldorwin]].{{ref/book|12|21}}
